svg.text: to shifter HV+, all four encoder Red wires

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Consolas, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: to both MDD20A VB+ and VB−

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Consolas, Courier New, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, Consolas, Courier New, monospace

svg.text: one common bus, no daisy chain
ESP32, buck, boost, both MDD20A logic GND,
shifter LV− and HV−, all four encoder Black wires
The Pi ground reaches the ESP32 ground through the USB cable.
* GPIO 34, 35, 36, 39 are input-only, with no internal pull-ups.
No strapping pins (0, 2, 5, 12, 15) and no flash pins (6 to 11) are used.
MOTOR_DIR_SIGN = ENC_DIR_SIGN = {-1, +1, -1, +1} for FR, FL, RR, RL.
They must match per motor, or the PID loop runs away.
Front encoders (GTK08): Green is A, White is B. Rear (RMCS-2086):
Yellow is A, Green is B. Check the wire, not the table.
Motor leads: Red to MxA, Black to MxB on all four motors.
VIN from the 5 V buck is a roadmap item, not done.
Not checked against the physical robot. Drawn from the firmware and the repo wiring docs.
